Rashi on Gittin 68b:11:1.hebrew: ובעיא מינטר ליבם קטן - עד שיביא שתי שערות ויהא ראוי לחליצה, ויודע היה זה שעתידה להמתין שלש עשרה שנה:
Rashi on Gittin 68b:11:1.english: And [she] must wait for a minor yavam - until he grows two [pubic] hairs and becomes fit for chalitzah, and this one [Ashmedai] knew that she was destined to wait thirteen years:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:12:1.hebrew: שבעה יומי לית ליה - אינו בטוח לחיות שבעה ימים, שמא למחר ימות:
Rashi on Gittin 68b:12:1.english: He does not have seven days - He is not assured of living seven days; perhaps tomorrow he will die:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:13:1.hebrew: אבי גזא - תחתיו היה אוצר גדול, זהב וכסף טמון:
Rashi on Gittin 68b:13:1.english: On the treasury - Beneath him was a great treasure, hidden gold and silver:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:14:1.hebrew: תרחיה גביה - איחר אצלו שלמה לאשמדאי. "תרח" בלשון ארמי איחור, כדאמרינן בבבא קמא (דף פ.): "מאן תרח? ניתרח שמואל":
Rashi on Gittin 68b:14:1.english: Tarcheih gabeih [He kept him with him] - Solomon detained Ashmedai with him. "Tarach" in the Aramaic language [means] delay, as we say in Bava Kamma (80a): "Who delayed? Let Shmuel delay":

Rashi on Gittin 68b:14:2.english: He was standing alone - Solomon [was] with Ashmedai:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:14:3.hebrew: כתועפות ראם לו - להקדוש ברוך הוא יש לו תועפות ראמים למשלחתו, וליפרע פורענות בשליחותו:
Rashi on Gittin 68b:14:3.english: Like the lofty horns of the wild ox for Him - The Holy One, blessed be He, has [these] lofty ones [angels and] wild oxen [demons] for His dispatch, and to exact retribution on His mission:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:14:4.english: What is your greatness - that the Holy One, Blessed be He, is praised through you:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:15:1.hebrew: עזקתך - טבעתו, היה שם חקוק עליה:
Rashi on Gittin 68b:15:1.english: Your ring - his ring; the [Divine] Name was engraved upon it:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:15:2.english: He threw him - He thrust him [away]:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:16:1.hebrew: גונדו - לבושו; ובביאורי טהרות דרב האי ראיתי: "קודו" — מקידה של חרס לשתות מים (סוטה דף לב:):
Rashi on Gittin 68b:16:1.english: His cloak [gundo] - [This means] his garment. And in the explanations of [Order] Tohorot by Rav Hai [Gaon], I saw [the reading] "kodo" — [meaning] an earthenware pitcher for drinking water (Sotah 32b):

Rashi on Gittin 68b:16:2.hebrew: לא סריך - אינו נדבק לומר דבר אחד של שטות כל הימים, שזה אומר "הייתי מלך" ואינו אומר דבר שטות אחרת:
Rashi on Gittin 68b:16:2.english: Does not cling - [An imbecile] does not stick to saying one foolish thing all the time, whereas this [man] says, "I was king," and does not say any other foolish thing:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:17:1.english: Check his feet - for a demon's feet resemble those of roosters:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:17:2.hebrew: במוקי קאתי - אינו בא לשכב יחף, אלא באנפילאות, קאלצונ"ש בלעז:
Rashi on Gittin 68b:17:2.english: He comes in socks [bemokei] - He does not come to lie [down] barefoot, but rather in socks — calçons in Old French:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:1:1.english: She begged him - to draw away from it [her shack] so that he would not rub against it:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:1:2.hebrew: כפא לקומתיה - לצד אחר, ואיסתלק עובי כתיפיו מן הבית:
Rashi on Gittin 68b:1:2.english: He bent his stature - to the other side, and the bulk of his shoulders moved away from the house:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:1:3.hebrew: ולשון רכה תשבר גרם - על ידי לשון רכה שחננה מענה רך, נשברה עצמי:
Rashi on Gittin 68b:1:3.english: And a soft tongue breaks a bone - Through a soft tongue, with which she pleaded [with] a soft reply, my bone was broken:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:20:1.hebrew: מלך והדיוט - היה שלמה, לא חזר שוב למלכותו:
Rashi on Gittin 68b:20:1.english: A king and a commoner - Solomon was [so]; he did not return again to his kingship:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:21:1.english: For blood of the head - A headache illness that comes due to blood:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:21:2.hebrew: שורבינא - מין ארז, כדאמרינן בראש השנה (דף כג.): "תאשור שורבינא":
Rashi on Gittin 68b:21:2.english: Shurvina - A species of cedar, as we say in Rosh Hashanah (23a): "Te'ashur [is] shurvina":

Rashi on Gittin 68b:21:5.english: Chilfa - [This is] tzafzafah, a tree whose name [in Old French] is poplier [poplar]:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:21:6.english: And sea willow - girofle [Old French for clove]:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:21:7.english: Yavla [cynodon grass] - A type of grass:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:22:2.hebrew: דקאי בחד דרא - כל עלין שלו מצד אחד, זה למעלה מזה:
Rashi on Gittin 68b:22:2.english: That stands in one row - All of its leaves are on one side, one above the other:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:23:1.english: For tzelichta [a migraine] - pain of half the head:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:23:2.english: With a white zuz - He should slaughter it with a dinar of refined silver:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:23:3.english: On this side that hurts him - [Meaning] that the blood should flow over the half of the head where the pain is:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:23:4.english: And he should hang it - the slaughtered rooster:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:23:5.english: On the doorposts of the gate - on the doorposts of the entrance:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:2:1.english: He brought him up - He raised him up to direct him onto the road:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:2:3.english: He brought him up - to the road:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:2:4.english: He saw a celebration in which they were rejoicing - He saw a bridal procession [where] they were rejoicing exceedingly:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:3:1.english: Drink overcame him - He drank a lot:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:4:1.english: Take food away from him - Withdraw your hands from feeding him, except a little:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:6:1.english: Whom he trusts by his oath - [He] trusts him on his oath when he swears to him to return it to him:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:7:1.english: That have no habitation - [i.e.,] of seeds and trees, to sustain himself there:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:7:2.hebrew: ופקע טורא - מתבקע מעט כמין חריץ, עד שמשליך שם זרע האילנות, וגדלים אילנות שם, ומתפרנס מהם:
Rashi on Gittin 68b:7:2.english: And the mountain splits - [It] splits slightly like a kind of crevice, until [the wild rooster] casts the seeds of trees there, and trees grow there, and he sustains himself from them.

Rashi on Gittin 68b:8:1.hebrew: בדקו קינא - בדקו עד שהיו בקיאין היכן יש קן של דוכיפת, דהוא תרנגולא ברא:
Rashi on Gittin 68b:8:1.english: They investigated a nest - They searched until they knew well where there was a nest of a hoopoe, which is [the] wild rooster:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:8:2.hebrew: זוגיתא - זכוכית, כדי שיראה את בניו ולא יוכל ליכנס אצלם, ויהא צריך לשמיר לבקע הזכוכית:
Rashi on Gittin 68b:8:2.english: Zugita - Glass, so that it would see its chicks and not be able to go in to them, and would need the shamir to split the glass:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:8:3.english: He cast at it - Solomon's emissary [cast] a shout:

Rashi on Gittin 68b:9:1.english: You brought him up [to his road] - Why were you concerned for him?
